ops.body: - **Phase 2 of Sights and Local life** (decision 0200): Culture and Community into Local life, museums, galleries, theaters, cinemas and community spaces out of the marks (an archive-recorded building or a "memorial"/"monument" name stays a Sight under History), "What I'm into" under the two headings, the out-of-town stars by the same rule, `PRESENCE_CODE` bumped and the goldens re-captured. Held until chronicles-data covers National Park Service sites or carries a listing flag, or Independence Hall, Congress Hall and the Betsy Ross House leave the marks.
ops.intro: The first phase was built Nov 18 (SG1-SG14); what it left and what it found.

ops.body: - **A kind's dots move between rows** (sights-and-local-life UI review, U2, before this slice): on a row with something the dots sit beside Suggest a walk, on a "none" row at the right edge, so a column of dots does not line up (M3 lists: "Don't vary the position of elements within a list"). Keeping the button's slot empty on a "none" row would align them.

- **"How the marks work" looks the same open and closed** (UI review U4, before this slice): no chevron that turns; `accessibilityState.expanded` is set, so only sight lacks it. The card also says "marks" where a reader says "dots" (the cold find).

- [ ] **Do:** with VoiceOver, then TalkBack, open an area's card and swipe through "What's here"; then look at a tile on a 320 pt wide phone with all eight kinds. **Expect:** "Sights" is read as a heading, then its line and its five kinds, then "Local life" as a heading and its three; the tile's icons stay one row, the Local life ones after a thin vertical line, the last inside the tile. (SG2, SG3, SG14)
